Complete Guide to Social Media Image Resizer

Every major social media platform enforces distinct image dimensions and aspect ratios. Posting an improperly sized banner or avatar results in awkward cropping, blurry re-compression, or cut-off logos. Remembering the ever-changing pixel requirements across platforms is difficult.

TECHTIS Social Media Image Resizer includes up-to-date 2026 presets for all primary social platforms: Instagram (Square Post 1080x1080, Portrait Post 1080x1350, Story/Reel 1080x1920), YouTube (Channel Banner 2560x1440, Video Thumbnail 1280x720), Twitter/X (Header 1500x500), LinkedIn (Company Banner 1584x396), and Facebook (Cover Photo 820x312).

Simply upload your image, pick your target social preset, and download the perfectly sized asset ready for immediate upload, with zero file uploads to external servers.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Social Media Image Resizer and privacy

What is the best image size for Instagram posts in 2026?
Instagram Portrait (1080 x 1350 px, 4:5 aspect ratio) is strongly recommended because it occupies the maximum vertical screen estate in the mobile feed, generating significantly higher engagement than standard 1:1 square posts.
Why do YouTube banners look blurry or cropped on phones?
YouTube requires a massive 2560 x 1440 px canvas to accommodate large 4K televisions, but mobile devices display only the central 'Safe Area' (1546 x 423 px). Our tool provides built-in safe zone visual guides so your text is visible on every screen.
Are my marketing graphics or branding photos uploaded to any server?
No! All image scaling and canvas rendering execute strictly inside your local browser memory. Your artwork is 100% confidential.
Can I export for multiple social platforms from a single image?
Yes! Select your artwork once and generate optimized assets for Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Facebook in one click.
Does this tool work on mobile phones?
Yes! You can resize and download social assets directly to your phone's photo gallery on iOS and Android.
Does TECHTIS add any watermarks to social media graphics?
Never. All exported images are 100% watermark-free and unrestricted.
What image formats are supported?
You can upload and export JPG, PNG, and modern high-efficiency WebP images.
Is there any cost for generating social media assets?
No. TECHTIS is 100% free forever with unlimited usage.
